Enemy shot windup ~0.45 s: `ENEMY_SHOT_WINDUP_MS=450`; enemy enters a windup (telegraph flag `enemy.windupRemainingMs > 0`) before firing, projectile only spawns when the windup completes; red glow telegraph in `combatRenderer` (R4, a11y rules 4 & 6). Unit test: windup delays the shot by ~450 ms.

Real dash on Shift: 0.18 s burst at 3× move speed with a 100 ms input buffer; cooldown by weight class — light 2.5 s (loadPct ≤ 80) / mid 3.5 s (≤ 100) / heavy 4.5 s (> 100), mirroring the weight.js 80/100 bands; `dashRemainingMs`/`dashCooldownMs` on the player (R2). Expect-style test asserts measured dash duration ≈ 0.18 s and the cooldown bands.

Overdraw actually slows fire rate: when the build is overdrawn, the player fire cooldown is multiplied by `1 + overdrawPenaltyPct/100` (fire rate scaled by output/draw) through the arena fire path (R4). Test: shots-per-second is strictly slower under overdraw than a balanced build.
